key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: Process–property equations can guide spray settings to target coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Vary nozzle passage speed and spray distance during detonation spraying.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive process–property equations and identify settings for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships of roughness and thickness with nozzle speed, and parabolic relationships of roughness and contact angle with spray distance.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical operating ranges or prediction errors, limiting assessment of the equations’ transferability.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
